page: Amazon Web Services c8gd.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro system and powered by custom AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 Graviton CPUs. It provides 4 physical ARM64 cores running at 2.8 GHz without hyperthreading, paired with 8.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per core). Cache specifications feature 64 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and a shared 36 MB L3 cache. Storage and network capabilities include 237 GB of bundled NVMe SSD local instance storage alongside a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluation shows top 25% single-threaded performance in bzip3 decompression. Standard compute and memory throughput tests place the instance in the middle 50% category, including Redis SET operations reaching 9.24 million ops/sec and static web serving throughput measured at 10.09 GB/sec. Conversely, synthetic PassMark encryption tests and LLM text generation metrics sit in the lower percentile ranges.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio delivers an efficient hardware allocation for processing-heavy workloads that do not require large memory arrays. Bundled high-speed local NVMe storage provides fast direct disk access without additional block storage latency. Primary target workloads include containerized compute, web serving, file compression and decompression pipelines, and lightweight database environments.
